name: welcome
subject: Welcome to ERP System - Your Business Management Solution
description: Welcome email for new ERP System users
bodyHtml:
Welcome to ERP System!

Hello User,

Your account has been successfully created in our comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning system.

You can now access your dashboard and start managing your business operations efficiently.

Access Your Account

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact our support team.

Best regards,
The ERP System Team
bodyText:
Welcome to ERP System - Your Business Management Solution

Hello ${firstName},

Your account has been successfully created in our comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning system.

You can now access your dashboard and start managing your business operations efficiently.

Access your account here: ${websiteUrl}

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact our support team.

Best regards,
The ERP System Team

name: welcome
subject: Добро пожаловать в ERP System - Ваше решение для управления бизнесом
description: Приветственное письмо для новых пользователей ERP System
bodyHtml:
Добро пожаловать в ERP System!

Здравствуйте, Пользователь,

Ваша учётная запись успешно создана в нашей комплексной системе планирования ресурсов предприятия.

Теперь вы можете получить доступ к своей панели управления и начать эффективно управлять бизнес-процессами.

Доступ к аккаунту

Если у вас есть вопросы, пожалуйста, не стесняйтесь обращаться в нашу службу поддержки.

С уважением,
Команда ERP System

name: password-reset
subject: Password Reset Request
bodyHtml:
Password Reset

You have requested to reset your password. Click the link below to set a new password:

Reset Password

If you did not request this, please ignore this email.

This link will expire in 24 hours.
bodyText:
Password Reset

You have requested to reset your password. Visit the following link to set a new password:
${resetUrl}

If you did not request this, please ignore this email.
This link will expire in 24 hours.

name: password-reset
subject: Passwort zurücksetzen
bodyHtml:
Passwort zurücksetzen

Sie haben das Zurücksetzen Ihres Passworts angefordert. Klicken Sie auf den Link unten, um ein neues Passwort festzulegen:

Passwort zurücksetzen

Falls Sie diese Anfrage nicht gestellt haben, ignorieren Sie bitte diese E-Mail.

Dieser Link läuft in 24 Stunden ab.
bodyText:

name: password-reset
subject: Réinitialisation du mot de passe
bodyHtml:

Si vous n avez pas fait cette demande, ignorez cet email.

Ce lien expirera dans 24 heures.
